triage.verifier_justification: I tried to refute the call three ways and each failed. (1) "Mechanical/rename": the two changed formula lines swap one caller input for a semantically different one — `entry_is_line_b` survives in the post file (it still defines `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded`) and `entry_is_section_232_aluminum` already existed pre-fix gating `section_232_aluminum_component_rate`, so this is a semantic substitution inside a boolean gate, not a rename or regeneration artifact. (2) "Not a defect / new coverage": the module already claimed the carve-out (its pre-fix proof atom cites the 9903.01.77 aluminum exception), and the pinned corpus confirms the source conditions it on membership, not on a line — 9903.01.77 reads "Except for products described in headings 9903.01.78-9903.01.83 and 9903.01.90, articles the product of Brazil..." and 9903.01.83 is "Articles of iron or steel; derivative articles of iron or steel; articles of aluminum; derivative articles of aluminum; ...". No provision conditions the carve-out on the witness exemplar line 7601.10.30.00, so the pre-fix branch had no source basis and the fix re-grounds it — untraceable_branch, not unrepresented_clause (the clause was present, just ungrounded) and not wrong_entity_or_scope (rule entity, geography and module scope are unchanged). (3) The steel hunk is provenance only: `ch38_s232_steel_heading_rate` keeps `formula: '0.50'` and only its citation path/excerpt/source string move from 9903.81.87/.88 (which does not resolve in this corpus vintage) to 9903.82.02 (which resolves with the matching "+ 50%" text), so it is mechanical and does not carry the verdict.

(b) Behavioral impact inside ch38 (chemical products) is probably nil for both operands, and the first reader's quote is from the PR body rather than the diff; but the formula and its input dependency did change, which is encoded meaning, so "mechanical" does not apply. Also note the pre- and post-fix proof atom for this clause cites us/statute/hts/chapter-99/page-219 with excerpt "The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02." — that page resolves in the pinned release to a bare list of HTS numbers, so the excerpt does not match its locator; unchanged by this commit, but it is a live provenance defect worth a separate case.
